about: Personal-note samples for the embedder bake-off (PLAN.md M4, P4). Each item is a text as a store would hold it (an observation in the owner's words, or a rendered fact) with one question per language asking for it. Questions are paraphrases: they share as few words with the text as the meaning allows, so what is measured is meaning, not spelling. Items in the same group share a name and differ in one thing; a query must rank its own item above the others in its group. Items n01-n60: texts and all three questions by the assistant (2026-09-11). Items n061-n200: texts and English questions by the assistant, German and Swedish translated by the local Qwen3.5 9B (items carry translated_by; 58 Swedish and 2 German translations were corrected by hand where the model produced a non-word, a literal mistranslation, or 'Vil' for 'Vilken'); on n01-n60 its translations scored within 0.03 of the assistant's for every model, same ranking.

q.de: Was ist mein Geburtsdatum?
q.sv: När är jag född?

items.text: Sofia and Alex married in 2003 in Lund.

q.en: In which year and town did we get married?
q.de: In welchem Jahr und in welcher Stadt haben wir geheiratet?
q.sv: I vilket år och i vilken stad gifte vi oss?

items.text: We moved from Stockholm to Switzerland in 2019 for my job.

q.en: Why did we leave Sweden?
q.de: Warum sind wir aus Schweden weggegangen?
q.sv: Varför lämnade vi Sverige?

items.text: Before Rüschlikon we rented in Kilchberg for a year.

q.en: Where did we live when we first arrived?
q.de: Wo haben wir gelebt, als wir erstmalig ankamen?
q.sv: Var bodde vi när vi först ankom?

items.text: I am considering selling the Malmö flat in 2028 when the lease ends.

q.en: What might happen to the apartment in Sweden in a couple of years?
q.de: Was könnte in ein paar Jahren mit der Wohnung in Schweden geschehen?
q.sv: Vad kan hända med lägenheten i Sverige om några år?

items.text: Alex has decided not to take the sabbatical after all.

q.en: Is the long break from work still happening?
q.de: Findet die lange Pause von der Arbeit immer noch statt?
q.sv: Blir det fortfarande en lång paus från jobbet?
